comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper stop versus stack a block while another robot works in the shared space.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires bimanual coaxial tool use; the tower task requires timed pick-and-place and inter-robot collision avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires retained angle over cycles; the tower task requires the green block resting on the tower with no arm contact.
comparison.reason: Shared use of two arms is superficial; the tower task tests coordination with another agent rather than adjustment locking.
